assertions.requirement: A closed kind/target selects the fixed registered capability and profile; specs cannot inject lifecycle callbacks, placement or evidence.
assertions.candidateEvidence: contracts/job-policy.ts and targets/job-profiles.ts; closed-spec ESLint and ordinary Vitest discovery controls.

assertions.requirement: Cleanup intent and a fresh complete inventory fence precede each send. Original controller, credential, explicit and resolved placement, provisional transitions and every validated attempt prefix survive missing replies or later failures.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/job-attempt-ledger.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/job-native-cleanup.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: JobAttemptLedger, JobNativeCleanup, public-cloud-job adapter and original-controller Workload mutation hook; strict inventory/provisional/lost-reply regressions.

assertions.requirement: Persisted terminal cleanup, complete attempt history and independent native absence are required before release; cleanup uses its original identity, independent cancellation scope and remaining deadline.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/job-native-cleanup.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #finalize; JobNativeCleanup and independent native readers; cancellation, partial-history and failed automatic-cleanup regressions.

assertions.requirement: Only the family finalizer consumes exact run/reference/generation-bound active and required extension evidence once, then releases children and shared resources before its sole completion result. Terminal-only, copied, mismatched, missing, early or reused records reject.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts: begin/progress/extension/terminal/claim; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #finalize; evidence ownership and finalizer controls.

assertions.requirement: The named forced failure follows the finalizing restart and produces no completion. An inconclusive race or a failed restart preserves primary and cleanup failures, and the outer runner retains native verification tracking for the member instead of releasing it. Compact pre-fault, post-fault, final-contents, fixture, cleanup and native records retain source, profile, run, attempt and generation for at least 30 days.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #evictionMember E2E_JOB_FORCE_CLEANUP; test/integration/helpers/common.sh: spot-eviction native verification retention; fixture-record/cleanup-observations/native records; existing e2e-job comparison artifact uploads and retention policy.

assertions.requirement: Register imported API credential intent before mutation, bind its original controller and provider identity, sanitize actual child environments and suppress secret-producing output before recording artifacts. Complete API absence readback precedes credential release.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: JobAuthorization bootstrap owner and JobPrivateCommands; isolatedJobEnvironment, JobCloudSession and ApiClient readback; original-controller, deadline, schema and redaction controls.

assertions.requirement: Bind the requested profile and observed image configuration/API manifest to the original active attempt and exact resolved placement. An omitted zone is accepted only for an originally null zone; explicit or known placement mismatches reject.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/job-attempt-ledger.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #cloudProgress active baseline; imageConfigDigest and original VmLedgerProbe/JobAttemptLedger observations.

assertions.requirement: An unpinned spot Job writes a 24 GiB payload and a marker to its output, flushes them, exits 0 and is observed Finalizing on exactly one live attempt whose native VM and boot disk are read back before the fault.

While the Job is Finalizing, evict its VM natively: `az vm simulate-eviction` on the exact original VM after an identity readback, falling back to `az vm stop` if the power state has not left running within 90 seconds; the gateway counts stopped and deallocated states as preempted.

After the fault, require a new Finalizing event with reason `final-bucket-sync-vm-restarted`, the original VM row ended and a new row for the same cloud_id, credential, placement and VM type, and no terminal state in between.
The Job ends Completed with exit code 0, and the output bucket holds the exact marker and the full-size payload object.
A final sync that completes before the eviction lands, with no restart event, fails as inconclusive and never passes.

A sibling spot Job with no retries that exits 0 ends Completed with end reason `exited`, never `reclaimed`. Azure has no reclaim notice and keeps the 150 s preemption grace, so its exit-to-terminal time is recorded, not asserted.
